**About The Company**
 Affirm is a financial technology company dedicated to reinventing credit to make it more honest, transparent, and user\-friendly. Our mission is to provide consumers with flexible payment options that allow them to buy now and pay later without hidden fees or compounding interest. We believe in creating a financial ecosystem built on trust, clarity, and fairness, empowering individuals to make confident purchasing decisions. As a remote\-first organization, Affirm leverages innovative technology and a collaborative culture to deliver seamless financial experiences to millions of users across the United States. Our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and employee well\-being positions us as a leading innovator in the fintech industry, focused on creating value for both our customers and stakeholders.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our Underwriting ML team at Affirm. In this role, you will be instrumental in developing, refining, and deploying machine learning systems that enable real\-time transaction decision\-making. Your primary focus will be on assessing repayment risks and the expected value of each Affirm checkout, ensuring our models are accurate, reliable, and scalable. You will work closely with experienced ML engineers, data scientists, platform teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to take models from initial concept through prototyping to production deployment. Additionally, you will be responsible for maintaining model health through robust measurement, monitoring, and retraining workflows. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast\-paced, innovative environment where your work directly impacts millions of consumers and merchants across the country.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 2\+ years of experience as a machine learning engineer or a PhD in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Data Science, or Statistics
* Proficiency in Python programming, with experience writing production\-quality code
* Hands\-on experience building and evaluating classification models, preferably gradient\-boosted decision trees (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost) or similar algorithms
* Experience with deep learning frameworks, particularly PyTorch
* Familiarity with distributed data processing or parallel compute frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or Dask
* Knowledge of ML lifecycle tools including Kubeflow, Airflow, MLflow, or equivalent platforms
* Experience using AI\-powered developer tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar to accelerate development workflows
* Ability to translate business problems into technical solutions, writing clear, well\-tested, and extensible code
* Comfort navigating large codebases, debugging, and providing constructive code reviews
* Strong ownership mindset with proactive feedback seeking and continuous learning
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration with technical and non\-technical teams
* Equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field


**Responsibilities**
* Develop and iterate on underwriting prediction models utilizing a variety of approaches for tabular and sequential data
* Build and scale feature pipelines and training datasets, integrating proprietary and third\-party signals in collaboration with data and platform teams
* Prototype innovative modeling ideas and features, conduct offline experiments, and implement the best\-performing approaches into production with appropriate risk controls
* Operationalize models by integrating them into batch and real\-time decision systems, ensuring high reliability, low latency, and operational robustness
* Instrument and monitor model and data health, establishing workflows for retraining and backtesting to maintain model accuracy over time
* Collaborate with Engineering, Risk Analytics, Product, and ML Platform teams to define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and communicate results effectively
* Continuously improve models and pipelines based on performance metrics, business needs, and evolving macroeconomic conditions


**Benefits**
* Comprehensive health care coverage, including premiums paid for employees and dependents
* Flexible Spending Wallets with stipends for technology, food, lifestyle needs, and family expenses
* Generous paid time off, including vacation and holidays, to support work\-life balance
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) enabling employees to buy Affirm shares at a discount
* Remote work flexibility with the option to work from anywhere within the United States
* Competitive compensation packages aligned with experience and location, including base salary and equity
* Opportunities for professional growth and development within a dynamic, innovative environment
